title: Claudboard Convention Catalog
description: Primary artifact on the analyse→generate path. Produced by /analyse, consumed by /generate and future /refresh. Location: <project>/.claudboard/catalog.json

schema_version.description: Catalog schema version. Consumers assert this matches their expected value; mismatch → clear error naming both versions.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this catalog was produced.

from_audit.description: true if produced by /analyse --audit and sibling to .claudboard/audits/*.md; false if produced by default /analyse.

repo.description: Absolute path to the analysed project root (reference repo in workspace mode, repo root in monorepo/single-project).

umbrella_root.description: Absolute path to the umbrella root — the directory that owns .claude/ and .claudboard/. Equal to repo for monorepo/single-project. Equal to the workspace directory for workspace mode (where .claude/ is reachable via the meta-repo symlink). Consumers write all artifacts relative to this path.

stacks.description: One entry per detected stack. A stack groups services that share a runtime/framework (e.g. java-spring, react-ts).

service_count.description: Number of services in this stack (within the single monorepo repo, for monorepo mode).

repo_count.description: Number of independent repos in this stack (workspace mode only). Disambiguates '5 React services in 1 monorepo repo' (service_count=5, repo_count=1) from '5 React repos in a workspace' (service_count=5, repo_count=5). Omitted in single-project and monorepo modes.

reference_service.description: Directory name of the reference service used for deep pass in default mode. null if not yet determined.

applicable_paths.description: Glob patterns covering all service directories in this stack. Used by /generate for rule paths: scoping.

exemplar_paths.description: Map of pattern-name → canonical exemplar file path within the reference service.

conventions.description: Project-wide canonical conventions. Values are short descriptive strings; null when undetected.

logging.description: Logging framework and pattern, e.g. 'SLF4J/Logback structured JSON', 'console.log plain'.

naming.description: Naming conventions summary, e.g. 'PascalCase classes, camelCase methods, kebab-case files'.

patterns.description: Keyed by pattern id (e.g. 'kafka_consumer', 'rest_controller', 'spock_spec', 'react_component'). Each value describes the canonical exemplar and usage.

exemplar_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the canonical exemplar file for this pattern. Used by /generate to derive skill reference content.

frequency.description: Count of files matching this pattern across the codebase.

variations.description: Known variant names or deviations from the canonical pattern.

applicable_paths.description: Glob patterns where this pattern appears. Subset of a stack's applicable_paths when monorepo-scoped.

proposed_artifacts.description: Deduplicated project-wide list of rules and skills to generate. /generate iterates this list exactly.

name.description: Artifact filename (rule) or directory name (skill), e.g. 'java-conventions' or 'kafka-consumer'.

paths.description: paths: globs for rules. null for global rules. null or omitted for skills.

exemplar.description: Relative path to exemplar file. Cross-references patterns[id].exemplar_path.

depth_signal.description: Adaptive depth signal: full (quality avg ≥7.0), medium (4.0-6.9), skeleton (<4.0).

adaptive_depth.description: Per-stack rule and skill depth signal, keyed by stack id.

audit_summary.description: Present only when from_audit: true. References audit files and surfaces top Watch findings.

audit_files.description: Relative paths to .claudboard/audits/<svc>.md files produced by this run.

top_watch_findings.description: Top cross-service Watch findings surfaced from audit reports.
